instruction: Help me enable repeat one mode in VLC to repeat the current video

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to enable VLC repeat mode by setting 'repeat=1' in vlcrc. The evaluator reads the configuration file and verifies repeat mode is enabled (value 1). Default value is 0 (disabled). Repeat mode replays the current item continuously.
